limitations: Small sample of ten length-limited traces; no claim of population precision, recall, or yield.
The audit is another assistant judgment, not human ground truth.
The generator/reviewer models and semantic prompts were held fixed. Network recovery and continuation after technical errors changed only execution handling.
No variants were silently relabeled or removed because of this audit.
